about: Cross-fades and tints (r94): each scene starts one 4 s in and lasts 4 s, so t6 is mid-fade and t12 after it. Read by ParallaxLab --shots and engines/godot/tests/shots.gd.

scenes.name: into-more-layers
scenes.about: Hiver (7 layers, repeat X, mirrored) into Calm (9 layers, another atlas): the 2 back layers of Calm have no counterpart

scenes.name: into-fewer-layers
scenes.about: Calm (9 layers) into OneNight (6 layers, useOriginalSize, dark gradients): the 3 back layers of Calm fade out alone

scenes.name: into-itself-tinted
scenes.about: repeat XY: a cross-fade into the page on screen (its layers cloned), while tinting orange

scenes.name: no-repeat-into-gradients
scenes.about: no repeat, white gradients into c06's coloured ones: the colours fade, the sizes stay c05's

scenes.name: tint-translucent
scenes.about: repeat Y, mirrored: a tint only, to a half-transparent night blue
